newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 2.6 pct vs. year ago -- EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 2.6 pct vs. year ago -- EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 62,113 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended Nov 16, up 2.6 percent from the same period in 1995, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said Tuesday.
The amount of power supplied to the West Central area rose the most from a year ago, up 6.1 percent to 4,713 GWh, the EEI said.
Year-to-date domestic power production totaled about 3.30 million GWh, up 2.6 percent from the same period in 1995, EEI said.
